intent.raw: Prepare a continuous plan that we can validate at the end.
intent.objective: Describe the dependency-ordered, fail-closed route from architecture selection through one aggregate candidate-validation wave.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Future implementation and independent validation span multiple owners.
subagent_strategy.explanation: This artifact describes execution but cannot delegate it. Repository-native delegation must first resolve through CA2-ROUTE-DELEGATE, and two or more helpers require a user-approved fan-out sheet.

steps.name: Select the exact governed-node architecture
stop_conditions: stop unless the human owner selects an exact immutable digest

steps.name: Close definitions and schemas

outputs.ref: W1 definition and schema candidate pack

stop_conditions: stop if any selected semantic field lacks a definition or falsifying fixture

steps.name: Align capability and business ontology

inputs.ref: W1 definition and schema candidate pack

outputs.ref: W2 capability and business ontology candidates

stop_conditions: stop if product behavior and ontology relationships do not recompose to the W1 semantic pack

steps.name: Author DomainSpec source

inputs.ref: W2 capability and business ontology candidates

outputs.ref: W3 authored DomainSpec and event-sourcing source

stop_conditions: stop if generated outputs are edited as authored source
stop if profile admission is inferred

steps.name: Compile deterministic graph and system ontology

inputs.ref: W3 authored DomainSpec and event-sourcing source

stop_conditions: stop on source drift, unadmitted profile, or unequal second-run bytes

steps.name: Implement the Rust governed-node runtime

outputs.ref: W5 runtime implementation and focused validation receipt

stop_conditions: stop if runtime behavior is absent from the compiled contract
stop if a projection becomes a replay source

inputs.ref: W5 runtime implementation and focused validation receipt

outputs.ref: W6 exact ConstructionBinding and conformance receipt

steps.name: Rehearse bounded migration
stop_conditions: stop unless the exact W6 candidate is accepted for rehearsal
stop before cutover or legacy-source mutation

steps.name: Run aggregate final validation

inputs.ref: W0-W7 immutable gate and execution receipts

convergence_criteria: all validations run against one frozen epoch
stop_conditions: never convert aggregate PASS into admission, publication, deployment, or cutover authority

gates.condition: Select one exact governed-node proposal digest.
Definitions, schemas, and negative fixtures close over the selected model.
Product Capability and business ontology are owner-bound before DomainSpec compilation.
The exact profile and authored source epoch are admitted before implementation claims depend on compiled outputs.
Runtime positive, negative, replay, and projection-source checks pass.
Exact binding and non-vacuous conformance pass; the immutable candidate is accepted for migration rehearsal.
Isolated migration is lineage-complete, deterministic, and non-destructive.
All checks run against one frozen epoch, all predecessor gates pass, and acceptance-critical residue is empty.

authority.acceptance_owner: human owners named at each gate

promotion_guardrails: Planning validation does not authorize task-session execution.
A focused PASS cannot replace a missing predecessor gate.
Aggregate W8 PASS remains candidate evidence only.
No migration cutover, publication, release, or deployment is in scope.
